column1: # Unreal Engine's allocator on a host malloc zone (nxnative/dm/host/hle_uemalloc.c; dm/games/game.py puts these rows in the profile header as DM_GAME_UE_MALLOC).
# Each row runs only on its main build. layout: UE5, UE4_27, UE5_6 (the vtable slots, hle_uemalloc.c k_lay); obj: the FMallocBinned object (main + obj, 0 = made by
# GCreateMalloc, given at the gate); vtable: main + vtable; cut: the cut constructor call (a nop after the rewrite, its patches.py).
# Chinese 1.0.4: nninitStartup's constructor call at 0x12e40 receives main+0x68022c8 (adrp/add at 0x12e38/0x12e3c); the constructor installs main+0x5b06f38 at 0x9f4b4..0x9f4c4.

# Octopath Traveler 0 1.0.5 (Chinese release): the same game as the row above, its own main build with the engine's data 0x3000 bytes higher: the FMallocBinned3 object (main+0x68052c8, bss), its vtable (main+0x5b09f38, 26 slots), the cut constructor call (main+0x12e40, a nop after the rewrite)
